Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. You can’t ignore digivolution requirements when using this card's inherited effect.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's inherited effect to digivolve this Digimon into [Wingdramon] in my hand regardless of its digivolution requirements?

Effect: [Your Turn] When any of your [Groundramon] are played, this Digimon may digivolve into [Wingdramon] in the hand for a digivolution cost of 3, ignoring digivolution requirements.
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] When any of your [Groundramon] are played, this Digimon may digivolve into [Wingdramon] in the hand without paying the cost.
